comment: Trigger evals: does each skill fire on a natural phrasing, in each runtime? The runner kills each session as soon as a skill invocation (or clean no-invocation turn end) is observed, so runs stay short and cheap. Alternates cover secondary trigger paths (run with --alternates).

scenarios.prompt: I'm thinking of building a PCF control to show a star rating on a form - is that the right approach, and what should I watch out for?
alternates: I redeployed my PCF control but the form still shows the old version - why?

scenarios.prompt: set up my new laptop for Power Platform development - install everything I need
alternates: add Copilot Studio development to my workstation setup

scenarios.prompt: pac isn't working and my auth profiles are a mess - check my setup and fix what's wrong
alternates: which account and tenant am I actually signed in as right now?

scenarios.prompt: plan a canvas app for field engineers to log site visits against Dataverse
alternates: why is my gallery only showing 500 records?

scenarios.prompt: I'm about to add a custom status choice column to my case table - anything I should know first?
alternates: my solution import failed with missing dependency errors

scenarios.prompt: I want to contribute a new skill to the powercademy-skills marketplace - walk me through writing the SKILL.md properly
alternates: review my draft SKILL.md against the powercademy house standard before I open the PR

scenarios.prompt: we deploy our Power Platform solutions by hand and it keeps going wrong - help me set up a proper ALM process
alternates: how many environments do I need for this project?

scenarios.prompt: promote my CustomerOnboarding solution from dev to the test environment
alternates: my solution import failed with a missing dependency error

scenarios.prompt: I'm about to rename a couple of actions in a flow that's already live in production - anything I should watch out for?
alternates: my child flow returns a different shape now and the parent flow says it succeeded but did nothing - why?
